metaphors.title: The Mathocalypse
metaphors.paraphrase: Names the sudden wave of AI-solved problems a Mathocalypse, an apocalypse for the field, with a friend's joke about the machines coming for one problem after another.
metaphors.style_hint: Ruined skyline under a red sky.

metaphors.title: Aladdin’s cave
metaphors.paraphrase: The flood of new results is a hoard of treasures from Aladdin's cave: dazzling, plentiful, and still to be sorted through and valued.
metaphors.style_hint: A cave mouth spilling coins and gems.

metaphors.title: Alien proofs
metaphors.paraphrase: A colleague's notes call the new proof some alien craziness, and say there is much to learn from the aliens: the proofs read as made by another civilization.
metaphors.style_hint: A strange spired structure that looks landed from elsewhere.

metaphors.title: Resort next to the rainforest
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematicians are like a hunter-gatherer expert in surviving the rainforest, when a giant resort hotel with heated pools opens beside him; he adapts by guiding tourists through the wilderness.
metaphors.style_hint: A hut at the edge of a forest beside a glass hotel.

metaphors.title: Teleported to a mountain peak
metaphors.paraphrase: Quoting Quanta's image: AI drops you on a mountain peak in fog with no map and no equipment, without the climb that would have taught you the terrain.
metaphors.style_hint: A summit in fog with a tiny figure on top.

metaphors.title: Undigested proofs
metaphors.paraphrase: One way of releasing AI results posts the undigested solutions and starts a race among humans to digest and explain a messy proof; the other has the finders write a digested version first.
metaphors.style_hint: A great pipe feeding an organ-like chamber.

metaphors.title: The accelerating AImobile
metaphors.paraphrase: In a reply, he warns of losing human hands at the wheel of this accelerating AImobile just when more are needed.
metaphors.style_hint: A car with no driver speeding down a track.
